shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall upright stone slab/monument
paired vertical columns of repeated framed motifs
anthropomorphic or face-like elements within the design
justification: Both surfaces show shallow relief on a tall upright monument dominated by rounded, cartouche-like blocks arranged in paired vertical columns, with curvilinear scrolls and at least one prominent disc motif in A; the repetitive framed-sign columns of B find a loose echo in the stacked motifs on A's upper section. However, A is a single sculpted figural body (a broad torso with a headdress-like upper zone, a central disc on the chest, and a banded belt), whereas B is a flat inscribed panel of uniform repeated glyph-like blocks with no overall figure, so the organising logic of the two designs differs substantially.
